entries.reason: R1 — SetRetryCommand constructs RetryRecoveryInput before metric/artifact mutation; it validates reset action, gate/review kind, allowed phase, trimmed reason length, and mandatory --yes, returning Envelope.fail on invalid input.; R2 — Recoverable target logic limits gate to task-impl/integration and canonical review to draft-questions/draft-coverage/spec/test/impl; gate draft/spec resolve as recoveryPossible:false with unsupported-plan-gate-phase, and set-retry input validation rejects gate draft/spec by allowing only gate recoverable phases.; R3 — Review FAIL paths persist a canonical phase recovery baseline when the next FAIL reaches maxAttempts, and review stop handling persists the baseline in the same mutation before writing reviewStop state.; R4 — set-retry checks exhausted attempts against resolved maxAttempts and calls buildRecoveryEligibilityForState, which uses resolveRecoveryEvidenceSource and latestMatchingBaseline by canonical kind/phase.; R5 — Exhausted reset checks eligibility before mutation; unchanged evidence returns Envelope.fail and exits before appending reset metrics, recovery artifact, or retry allowance metrics.; R6 — Eligible exhausted reset appends retry-recovery.json and issue-log entries with all required audit fields.; R7 — Recovery grant appends reset plus canonical-phase delta=maxAttempts-1 metrics, and existing gate/review PASS paths still append reset metrics to clear counters.; R8 — Diff adds retryRecovery views to next-action and status for exhausted review/gate stops, exposing kind, phase, canonicalPhase, attempts, max, recoveryPossible, recoveryReason, changedEvidence, and recoveryCommand fields.; R9 — Recovery grant sets counter to maxAttempts-1; subsequent FAIL increments back to exhaustion, and no automatic recovery grant path is introduced.; R10 — CLI help and flow prompts were updated, and the source skill template mentions reason/audit/one re-evaluation/unchanged rejection, but the generated .agents/.claude skill files in the diff do not include the retry recovery guidance update.; R11 — Spec-local test file added under specs/260-post-retry-recovery/tests covers eligible recovery, unchanged rejection, one-attempt allowance, audit artifact/issue-log creation, and next-action/status display.
